name: Lorentz Butterfly
bio: Archetype: Lingering Glow, Skill Reuse, Self Rankup. ⌽ Raise [Burn] cap and increase DMG Bonus and Incantation Might based on number of [Lingering Glow] stacks and allies. ⌽ [Lingering Glow] units gain Moxie at turn end if they didn't use Ultimate that turn, and their Ultimates don't take up deck space. ⌽ Skills rank up when used depending on the number of skills of the same type used that turn. High tier Skill 1 deals fixed damage proportional to total skill damage dealt during the turn. ⌽ Skill 2 allows [Lingering Glow] units to inflict more [Burn]. ⌽ Ultimate creates several copies of a selected skill to be used next turn without generating Moxie or spending AP.
